title: Electromagnetics
objectives:
This course is an introductory subject on electromagnetics and includes fundamental concepts
and applications of Maxwell equations.
syllabus:
Review of mathematical concepts, Electrostatics in vacuum, Magnetostatics in vacuum,
Induced electromagnetic fields, Symmetries and conservation laws, Electromagnetic waves,
Interference phenomena, The electromagnetic field of moving charges, Radiation from
localized sources, Motion of charges and moments in external fields, Action formulation of
electromagnetism, Electromagnetic fields in material media, Electrostatics around
conductors, Electrostatics of dielectrics, Magnetostatics in matter, Ohm’s law, emf, and
electrical circuits, Frequency-dependent response of materials, Quasistatic phenomena in
conductors, Electromagnetic waves in insulators, Electromagnetic waves in and near
conductors, Scattering of electromagnetic radiation, Formalism of special relativity, special
relativity and electromagnetism, Radiation from relativistic sources.
textbooks:
1. Anupam Kumar Garg, "Classical Electromagnetism in Nutshell", 2012.
2. Tamer Becherrawy, "Electromagnetism: Maxwell Equations, Wave
Propagation and Emission", 2012.
3. John R. Reitz, "Foundation of Electromagnetic Theory", 4th Edition, 2009.
